label: Tareas Completadas
description: Número total de tareas completadas en el período
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabWH Task` WHERE status = 'DONE' AND (%(date_from)s IS NULL OR modified >= %(date_from)s) AND (%(date_to)s IS NULL OR modified <= %(date_to)s)

label: Tareas Atrasadas
description: Número de tareas con fecha de entrega vencida
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabWH Task` WHERE status != 'DONE' AND due_date < CURDATE()

label: Ventas del Mes
description: Número de pedidos de venta creados este mes
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabSales Order` WHERE MONTH(transaction_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(transaction_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())

label: Pedidos Pendientes
description: Pedidos de venta que aún no han sido entregados
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabSales Order` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Closed', 'Cancelled')

label: Ingresos del Mes
description: Ingresos totales de pedidos de venta en el mes actual
data_source: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(grand_total), 0) as value FROM `tabSales Order` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND MONTH(transaction_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(transaction_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())

label: Ordenes de Trabajo Pendientes
description: Ordenes de trabajo en estado pendiente o en progreso
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabWork Order` WHERE status IN ('Not Started', 'In Process', 'Material Transferred')

label: Ordenes de Trabajo Completadas
description: Ordenes de trabajo completadas en el período
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabWork Order` WHERE status = 'Completed' AND (%(date_from)s IS NULL OR modified >= %(date_from)s) AND (%(date_to)s IS NULL OR modified <= %(date_to)s)

label: Proyectos en Riesgo
description: Proyectos con tareas atrasadas o bloqueadas
data_source: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT project) as value FROM `tabWH Task` WHERE (status = 'BLOCKED' OR (status != 'DONE' AND due_date < CURDATE())) AND project IS NOT NULL AND project != ''

label: Velocidad del Equipo
description: Promedio de tareas completadas por semana en los últimos 30 días
data_source: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) / 4.0, 1) as value FROM `tabWH Task` WHERE status = 'DONE' AND modified >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

label: Leads del Mes
description: Número de leads creados este mes
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabLead` WHERE MONTH(creation) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(creation) = YEAR(CURDATE())

label: Tasa de Conversión
description: Porcentaje de leads convertidos a clientes este mes
data_source: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabLead` WHERE status = 'Converted' AND MONTH(modified) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(modified) = YEAR(CURDATE())) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabLead` WHERE MONTH(creation) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(creation) = YEAR(CURDATE())), 0), 1), 0) as value

label: Campañas Activas
description: Número de campañas de marketing actualmente en ejecución
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabCampaign` WHERE CURDATE() BETWEEN COALESCE(start_date, '1900-01-01') AND COALESCE(end_date, '2099-12-31')

label: Tamaño del Equipo
description: Número de usuarios activos en el sistema
data_source: SELECT COUNT(*) as value FROM `tabUser` WHERE enabled = 1 AND user_type = 'System User'

label: Cumplimiento de Meta
description: Porcentaje de cumplimiento de meta de ventas del mes
data_source:
# Calculate sales target completion percentage
import frappe
from frappe.utils import flt

# Get current month sales
sales_result = frappe.db.sql("""
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(grand_total), 0) as total
    FROM `tabSales Order`
    WHERE docstatus = 1
    AND MONTH(transaction_date) = MONTH(CURDATE())
    AND YEAR(transaction_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())
""", as_dict=True)

current_sales = flt(sales_result[0].total if sales_result else 0)

# For now, use a default monthly target of 100000
# This could be fetched from a settings DocType in the future
monthly_target = 100000

if monthly_target > 0:
    value = (current_sales / monthly_target) * 100
else:
    value = 0

label: Valor Promedio de Pedido
description: Valor promedio de los pedidos de venta del mes
data_source: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(grand_total), 0) as value FROM `tabSales Order` WHERE docstatus = 1 AND MONTH(transaction_date) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND YEAR(transaction_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())

label: Eficiencia de Producción
description: Porcentaje de ordenes de trabajo completadas a tiempo
data_source: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabWork Order` WHERE status = 'Completed' AND actual_end_date <= expected_delivery_date AND MONTH(modified) = MONTH(CURDATE())) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `tabWork Order` WHERE status = 'Completed' AND MONTH(modified) = MONTH(CURDATE())), 0), 1), 0) as value
